context_for_next_testing_agent: Division Manager feature fully implemented. Backend CRUD APIs verified working. Frontend component integrated into AdminPage under League Management > Divisions tab. TeamManager loads divisions from API for dropdown. Admin page requires Google OAuth authentication to access.

GET /api/divisions.details: Returns list of all divisions with id, name, level, color, description fields. No MongoDB _id exposed.

POST /api/divisions.details: Creates new division with validation (name required, duplicate name rejected). Returns created division.

PUT /api/divisions/{id}.details: Updates existing division. Returns 404 for non-existent division. Changes persist correctly.

DELETE /api/divisions/{id}.details: Deletes division. Returns 404 for non-existent. Validates no teams assigned before deletion.
